title: A Cape Cod couple moved into their newly built dream home in March 2025
summary_full: In Massachusetts, a newly built residence was taken by state officials for a bridge project, much to the dismay of the Hendel couple who relocated there only a month prior. This eminent domain decision affects thirteen properties in Round Hill as the state prepares for Sagamore Bridge's replacement, causing distress over disrupted retirement plans and unsettled financial futures.
